commands.result: Configuration validated without exposing environment values
Backend and frontend current-source images built successfully
Database, backend, and frontend services healthy
Backend health and frontend root returned HTTP 200
Owned account list returned eligible types only; invalid date, Cash-limit, and insufficient-balance requests each returned HTTP 400; transaction count remained stable

limitations: Successful create and concurrent balance-update outcomes were assessed from inspectable source/build evidence; bounded runtime validation deliberately avoided persisting synthetic financial data.
Only aggregate booleans and HTTP status codes were retained; no credential, token, account identifier, balance, or transaction payload was persisted.
